attributes.action: Police Must stop and search people in Public Spaces for Knives.
attributes.additional_details: Should still be safe to go to Parks, on Trains and Buses, City Centres, so stop and search is the only way, if Caught Prison and Large Fine, I would Not worry on being Searched, let’s make going out Safe again, please support this to Curb the amount carrying Knives.
attributes.background: Since the Police Stopped Searching people who they Suspect of Carrying a Knife STABBING has increased Massively, in the news more or less Daily, as it’s more or less out of Control things need Sorting ASAP to save Lives, even young Teenagers are Stabbing, was not like it so bring it back to that.

rejection.details:
The police already have powers to stop and search people they reasonably suspect of carrying knives or other weapons.

You can find out more here:
https://www.gov.uk/police-powers-to-stop-and-search-your-rights/police-powers-stop-search

Decisions about when to use these powers are operational matters for the police.
